name: UGC 3966 (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 3966, a low surface brightness dwarf galaxy in the Lynx-Cancer void, seen by Hubble.
label: ugc3966-hubble
story: This faint, low surface brightness dwarf lies in the Lynx-Cancer void. Hubble resolved its stars to gauge its distance, part of a map of the nearby universe.

claims.text: UGC 3966 (DDO 46) is a low surface brightness dwarf, type Im, in the Lynx-Cancer void sample
The program measured distances to nearby galaxies from the luminosities of red giant branch stars, to build 3D maps of galaxies
